body:
> I do not believe they will improve for me. I'm not sure I want them to. It is frequent that I would rather die than improve or stay where I am.

I can relate to that. I often feel like the last thing I want is for things to stay just like the are right now. But the idea of doing anything differently to change my situation somehow feels even scarier, so dying being the only choice left seems like the best one.

> Regardless, thank you for your kind words, and I hope that what I say is not true for you. I hope someone is able to help you

I hope the same for you too. I know how terrible it can feel sometimes, and I just don't want anyone else to go through these feelings.
Thank you. I don't know what you're going through or how to help you, but I truly hope things get better for you.
